svg.title: Coupure - page 1
svg.text: A table row split across pages
One row too tall for what is left of the page, continued on the next. Look for the description carrying on
where it stopped rather than restarting or dropping a line, for the grid being redrawn around each half
so no text floats outside the table, for the short cell beside it still being drawn though it has nothing left
to say - a row showing fewer cells than the table has columns is refused by veraPDF and unreadable
aloud - and for the header repeating above the continuation.
